description: Closed SemGard profile inventory for semantic tagging of text segments in prompt-injection detection. Compatible with the MorphoRepr grammar (Appendix A), extended with ordered prefix classes (form, addressee). Strict ASCII tags.

kash.meaning: hidden: the segment comes from an explicitly non-displayed or secondary channel (HTML comment/hidden element, metadata, zero-width)
kash.covers: content extracted from a non-displayed channel
kash.excludes: visible but unobtrusive content (footer, small font)

kod.meaning: encoded: the segment was obtained by Base64 or hexadecimal decoding
kod.covers: segments produced by Base64 or hexadecimal decoding
kod.excludes: text merely written in a foreign language

vi.meaning: addressed to the AI system (assistant, model, agent, tool) — second person directed at the machine
vi.covers: you/tu/vous + assistant/AI/model/Claude/ChatGPT/system; “as an AI”; response-format instructions
vi.excludes: second person addressed to a human reader (manual, ticket addressed to a colleague)

mal.meaning: contrary: asks to invert or contradict the topic (ignore rules, disobey)
mal.covers: ignore, disregard, override, oublie, n’applique plus
mal.excludes: a mere mention of a rule

ne.meaning: absence: asks not to do something or to suppress it (do not mention, do not warn)
ne.covers: do not warn, ne mentionne pas, sans avertissement
ne.excludes: negation of a fact (“the file does not exist”)

regul.meaning: rules, system instructions, previous instructions, guardrails
regul.covers: instructions, system prompt, guidelines, policy, restrictions, consignes
regul.excludes: business rules described inside a document (quoted internal regulations)

rol.meaning: identity, persona, or role the system is asked to adopt
rol.covers: you are now, act as, pretend, roleplay, DAN, tu es désormais
rol.excludes: the role of a fictional character without addressing the system

ilo.meaning: tools, actions, and execution (tool calls, commands, navigation, sending)
ilo.covers: execute, run, call, curl, send, fetch, exécute, lance, envoie, ouvre
ilo.excludes: description of a tool in documentation

sekr.meaning: secrets and sensitive data: keys, passwords, tokens, personal data, prompt contents
sekr.covers: API key, password, token, credentials, system prompt contents, confidential data
sekr.excludes: the word “secret” in a narrative sense

elig.meaning: output: expected response form, content, or language
elig.covers: respond only with, answer in, output, print, réponds par, ta réponse doit
elig.excludes: program output described in a log

dat.meaning: neutral content: data, logs, informative prose without addressing the system
dat.covers: log lines, ordinary form fields, documentary text

ig.meaning: causative: cause or make something happen (make a secret leave, make a tool execute)
ig.excludes: a direct action by the speaker

u.meaning: directive (volitive): instruction, order, or addressed request

us.meaning: hypothetical / fictional: imagine, suppose, in a scenario

o.meaning: nominal: mention of an entity without a marked speech act
